column5: Purpose of This Spreadsheet is to Outline the Methodology of System 30

column3:
System uses:  Daily Bars using Alpaca Data ( ADJ Close 
           Price) (Initial Equity is based on $100,000 per day and resets 
           each day)
column10:
The methodology starts with a ETF ticker universe of 694 
             after the 3rd filter (see filter list)

Proprietary backtesting process, generates millions of RSI 
             branch variations for each ETF ticker and backtests them 
             on the prior in-sample year.

column3:
This is a composite ETF system using mean reversion RSI 
          signals to indicate extreme overbought conditions
column10:
This Branch selection methodology starts from a premise 
             that Out-of-Sample is the year N (2020) and the In-Sample 
             Is Year N-1 (2019), meaning each OOS Year will use the 
             year before it as IS (Yearly Rolling)

column3:
Unlike traditional RSI systems which uses ETFs, we use a "
           Branch Logic,Selecting Methodology" which 
           uses a proprietary filtering system for categorizing and 
           selecting branches.
column10:
For each ticker, it keeps only 1 Branch that passes the 
             IS filters: positive Profit %, at least 5% Time in Market, 
             and Max DD% no worse than 15%.

column3: We use three core filters in order to determine which branches to trade.

column10:
• If we have Multiple Branches With the same Lowest 
                    Max DD,we take higher IS Profit %
• If thats also the same we take higher IS Total Trades.

• If all Tie Breakers match then we take the 1st 
                    generated Alphabetically  branch with Lowest 
                    IS Max DD %

column10:
That selected branch is then applied to the next 
             out-of-sample year, and the process rolls forward year by 
             year to produce the final OOS results and yearly summary.
